jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Product Analytics
jobs.description:
Build AI contracting at enterprise scale. Ship it fast.

Ironclad is building AI on one of the most consequential datasets in enterprise software: over 2 billion contracts across thousands of the world's largest organizations. Contracts run every dollar, deal, and business relationship on the planet, and the AI transformation of this space is still largely uncharted. Engineers here are building agentic solutions to problems that haven't been solved yet, in a category that's still being defined. The feedback loop is short, the data is rich, and the people closest to the work are the ones deciding what gets built next. That ability to deliver impact quickly is why the the companies at the forefront of AI choose Ironclad to manage their contracts.

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com http://www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.



This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is required at least twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.



About the Role

As a Staff Product Analytics Data Scientist, you will be the analytical backbone of how Ironclad understands, measures, and improves its product. You'll turn raw product usage and contract data into a deep, quantitative understanding of how customers adopt our platform and our AI and you'll translate that understanding into decisions that shape the roadmap.

This is a builder's role. Our team owns its own data end to end: we model and maintain our own dbt pipelines, mine large and messy datasets for signal, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to ship data products that put insight directly into customers' and teammates' hands. You'll wear a product analytics hat most days, an analytics engineering hat when the pipeline needs it, and a data science hat when a problem calls for experimentation, causal inference, or modeling. As a Staff-level individual contributor, you'll set analytical direction, raise the technical bar across the team, and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.



What You'll Do

 - Own product understanding. Define, instrument, and analyze the metrics that describe how customers adopt, retain, and get value from Ironclad—funnels, activation, feature adoption (including our AI features like Jurist), engagement, and retention—and make them trustworthy and self-serve.

 - Drive experimentation and causal analysis. Design and analyze A/B tests and quasi-experiments; apply causal inference where clean experiments aren't possible; and give Product and Engineering clear, defensible reads on what actually moved the needle.

 - Mine data for opportunity. Explore large, complex product and contract datasets to surface non-obvious patterns, quantify opportunities, and generate hypotheses that shape strategy—not just answer questions that were already asked.

 - Build and evolve data products. Partner with Product and Engineering to turn analysis into shipped features—embedded analytics, benchmarks, insights, and AI-powered experiences—that deliver value directly to customers and internal teams.

 - Wear the analytics engineering hat. Own and extend the dbt models and transformations that power your work. Because our team owns its pipelines, you'll design scalable, well-documented, well-tested data models and uphold consistent definitions across the warehouse and BI layer.

 - Architect AI-ready data. Leverage AI to accelerate your own pipeline and analysis work, and structure our data assets, documentation, and metadata so that both humans and LLMs can navigate them with high confidence and minimal hallucination.

 - Set the bar and mentor. Provide technical direction, code and analysis reviews, and mentorship to analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers—fostering a culture of rigor, collaboration, and impact.

 - Influence senior stakeholders. Bring clarity to ambiguous, high-stakes product questions and communicate findings in a way that drives alignment and action across Product, Engineering, and leadership.

 - Self-serve enablement: Design and scale self-serve analytics ecosystems, semantic layers, and clear data documentation that empower non-technical stakeholders to answer their own data questions with confidence.



What We're Looking For

 - 8+ years of experience in product analytics, data science, or a closely related quantitative field, including demonstrated impact at a senior or staff level (ideally at a B2B SaaS company).

 - Deep expertise in product analytics: experimentation and A/B testing, funnel and retention analysis, causal inference, and defining product metrics that stand up to scrutiny.

 - Advanced SQL, plus fluency in Python or R for analysis, statistics, and modeling.

 - You can own dbt models, data modeling, and ELT best practices, and you're comfortable being the person who fixes the pipeline rather than filing a ticket.

 - A track record of partnering with Product and Engineering to ship data products or data-informed features, not just deliver dashboards and reports.

 - Strong data mining and exploratory instincts: you find the signal in large, messy datasets and know which findings are worth acting on.

 - Experience (or strong interest) in AI-assisted development and "AI-ready" data—using tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and writing documentation and metadata that help humans and LLMs work with data reliably.

 - Familiarity with a modern data stack such as Segment, Fivetran, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, Looker, and exploration tools like Hex (or their equivalents).

 - A self-starter who leads initiatives end to end, communicates with clarity, and bridges technical work and business impact.



Base Salary Range: $180,000 - $220,000 offers company bonus

The base salary range represents the minimum and maximum of the salary range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our base salary is just one component of Ironclad’s competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.


US Full-Time Employee Benefits at Ironclad:

 - 100% health coverage for employees (medical, dental, and vision), and 75% coverage for dependents with buy-up plan options available

 - Market-leading leave policies, including gender-neutral parental leave and compassionate leave

 - Family forming support through Maven for you and your partner

 - Paid time off - take the time you need, when you need it

 - Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) cell phone use

 - Mental health support through Modern Health, including therapy, coaching, and digital tools

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (US Employees)

 - 401(k) plan with Fidelity with employer match (US Employees)

 - Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun

 - And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at

**UK Employee-specific benefits are included on our UK job postings

This PM will own the features and systems that bring contract data into Ironclad and make it useful within the core product experience. This includes importing contracts and related metadata from customer systems, transforming it into reliable and connected knowledge, and exporting data and insights back into the tools and processes customers depend on.



We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to bring Ironclad’s strategy to life for the next generation of context-aware products and AI agents. You will define how contract data is ingested, normalized, enriched, connected, governed, and made available across the platform—powering our context knowledge graph and enabling AI agents, search, analytics, and workflows to reason over a customer’s business. You will develop strategies that ensure data is accurate and trustworthy. On top of that context knowledge graph you will build the agent experiences that turn this imported data into action: predicting cycle times, routing work, identifying risk, reconciling contract terms with external systems, and surfacing recommendations to the right people at the right time.



This role sits at the intersection of customer problems, data architecture, product strategy, and AI. You will determine which data Ironclad needs to capture, how it should be represented, how we preserve meaning and provenance as it moves through the platform, and how customers can trust, correct, and act on it. You will partner closely with the Search and Contract Understanding Platform, whose team turns contracts into accurate, structured, actionable knowledge. Together, you will create a durable data foundation that makes that knowledge available across products and connected to the systems and business context around it.



This is a high-impact role for a product leader who can move comfortably between customer discovery, data modeling, technical architecture, detailed requirements, and cross-functional execution.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the data import experience and product features. Make it easy for customers to bring in contracts and metadata from communications platforms, 3rd party repositories, shared drives, and other business applications while preserving structure, relationships, permissions, and provenance.

 - Build upon Ironclad’s context knowledge graph foundation. Define how contracts, clauses, terms, entities, workflows, approvals, counterparties, obligations, and related business objects are connected so Ironclad can provide context—not just isolated fields—to users and AI systems.

 - Make data useful across the platform. Establish the shared schemas, APIs, events, identifiers, lineage, and access patterns that let Search, Smart Import, Workflows, Analytics, and AI Agents build on consistent, trusted data. Ensure imported data can support both interactive experiences and background agents that continuously monitor, predict, validate, and act throughout the contracting process.

 - Build AI agents on imported data. Partner with AI, Engineering, Design, and domain experts to identify high-value agent use cases, define the data and context each agent needs, and ship agents that predict, recommend, triage, validate, reconcile, and execute work across legal, procurement, sales, finance, and operations. Own the quality bar for agent behavior, including grounding, explainability, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, monitoring, and safe failure modes.

 - Create a data quality and trust flywheel. Define completeness, accuracy, freshness, consistency, lineage, and coverage metrics; build feedback loops; and ensure customers can understand, validate, correct, and improve the data powering their experiences.

 - Partner on contract understanding. Work closely with the Contract Understanding Platform team on the boundaries between ingestion, extraction, enrichment, graph construction, and serving—so data is built once, improved continuously, and reusable everywhere.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of product management experience, including staff-level ownership in a data rich environment with a proven track record of building user-facing experiences.

 - Zero-to-one product development experience building AI solutions. This is a role that requires conceptual thinking about how to build AI capabilities that leverage Ironclad's vast pool of data.

 - Strong quantitative judgment and experience defining metrics, instrumentation, quality thresholds, and feedback loops for data and platform products.

 - Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (Series B through IPO).

 - Enterprise-product judgment where trust, security, compliance, portability, and workflow integration matter.

 - Excellent customer empathy, written communication, and ability to make complex technical and product concepts clear to diverse audiences.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across Engineering, Design, Data, AI, GTM, and executive stakeholders.

 - Experience with contract lifecycle management, document AI, legal technology, data migrations, or knowledge graphs is a plus, not a requirement.

The base salary range represents the minimum and maximum of the salary range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our base salary is just one component of Ironclad’s competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.

For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com http://www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.



This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is required at least twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.


About this role:

This is one of the most consequential product roles at Ironclad. You'll set the multi-year direction for two deeply connected halves of our AI platform, split roughly evenly: Search and Contract Understanding. On the search side, you own how customers and agents find and retrieve the right knowledge across their entire contract repository. On the understanding side, you own the extraction and document understanding systems that turn contracts into accurate, structured, actionable knowledge. The two reinforce each other: the richer and more structured our contract understanding, the more powerful, precise, and trustworthy Search becomes. Getting this right is fundamental to Ironclad's position as the leading AI contracting platform.

As a Principal PM, you operate as a force multiplier. You'll define the strategy and technical product direction that other teams build against. You'll own search quality end to end, driving relevance, ranking, and recall, and turn structured understanding into precise, high-recall queries across a customer's repository. You'll own extraction quality from document import to structured data to export, go deeper than flat properties to capture the relationships between clauses, terms, and contracts, and shape how that data is built once and served to every team that depends on it. You'll partner across engineering, applied science, design, legal experts, and GTM, and you'll set direction in ambiguity that others can execute against with confidence.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Own search quality end to end. Set the vision, roadmap, and OKRs for search, and stay accountable for relevance, ranking, and recall so users and agents reliably surface the right contracts and clauses.

 - Turn understanding into precise retrieval. Translate structured contract understanding into high-recall, high-precision queries across a customer's entire repository, and close the loop so richer understanding continuously raises search quality.

 - Own extraction quality end to end. Stay accountable for extraction accuracy, depth, and coverage from import through export, including long documents, multi-agreement detection, and bulk extraction.

 - Model the relationships in a contract. Move from flat properties to a connected representation that captures clauses, topics, intra- and inter-contract relationships, and negotiation history, so search and agents reason relationally and with high recall.

 - Build the data once, serve it everywhere. Define the APIs, schemas, and developer experience that let every client team, starting with search, build on a single, consistent understanding service.

 - Own the AI quality flywheel. Build the datasets, evals, production metrics, regression gates, and feedback loops that separate benchmark scores from real production quality across search and extraction.

 - Lead through influence. Make consequential technical calls (retrieval architecture, model choices, vendors, build-versus-buy) and align engineering, design, data, executives, and partners around clear decisions and accountable execution.

Qualifications:

 - 10+ years of product management experience of a technically complex, business-critical product area with company-level impact.

 - Deep experience shipping production search or information retrieval products, and production AI/ML, developer platform, or data infrastructure products.

 - Practical fluency with retrieval and ranking, LLM systems, extraction, APIs, data models, evaluation methods, latency, and cost.

 - Exceptional quantitative judgment, including the ability to reason about search relevance and recall, and to build offline benchmark performance from production traces.

 - Platform instincts at scale: you solve immediate needs while extracting durable, shared capabilities that many teams depend on.

 - A history of owning customer-facing outcomes and deep infrastructure in the same mandate.

 - Enterprise-product judgment that incorporates trust, scale, and compliance.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence and align executives, and to raise the bar for the PMs and engineers around you.

 - Experience with search or retrieval systems, document AI, knowledge graphs, and/or legal tech, is a plus.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Procurement teams need more than a repository for contracts. They need an intelligent system that helps them understand supplier relationships, prevent leakage, manage commitments, prepare for renewals and amendments, and turn contract data into negotiation leverage.



We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the next generation of AI-powered procurement experiences at Ironclad. You will own product strategy and execution across capabilities such as supplier and contract intelligence, obligations, renewals, amendments, risk insights, and procurement workflows.



This role sits at the intersection of procurement operations, legal contracting, enterprise workflow design, and applied AI. You will work directly with procurement and legal users, partner closely with engineering, design, data, applied AI, and go-to-market teams, and turn ambiguous customer problems into products that are trusted, measurable, and adopted.



The right person is equally comfortable in a procurement workflow review, a customer conversation, an AI evaluation discussion, and a roadmap tradeoff. You do not need to be an AI researcher—but you should be curious about how models, data, retrieval, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls come together in a production product.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a meaningful part of Ironclad's procurement AI product area.

 - Develop a deep understanding of procurement and legal workflows, including intake, supplier and contract management, obligations, renewals, amendments, risk review, and negotiation preparation.

 - Identify high-value opportunities where contract intelligence and AI can help procurement teams save time, prevent leakage, reduce risk, and gain leverage.

 - Shape experiences that connect structured contract data with actionable workflows—for example, supplier relationship views, contract-family intelligence, obligation tracking, renewal preparation, amendment drafting, risk insights, and consolidation opportunities.

 - Partner with engineering, applied AI, data, and design to define the right product architecture, user experience, data requirements, and human approval points.

 - Define how we measure AI quality in production, including accuracy, coverage, latency, task success, user acceptance, trust, and business value.

 - Build feedback loops that let users review, accept, reject, and improve AI-generated insights and actions.

 - Make complex enterprise workflows feel simple, explainable, and controllable while preserving the nuance that procurement and legal users need.

 - Lead customer discovery, design-partner programs, usability testing, and product validation with procurement, legal, finance, and operations teams.

 - Translate customer evidence and product data into clear prioritization decisions, product requirements, and execution plans.

 - Partner with GTM, Solutions, Sales, and Customer Success on positioning, launches, enablement, adoption, and value realization.

 - Drive products from discovery through launch and iteration, including clear go/no-go decisions and post-launch measurement.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Procurement and legal customers use Ironclad as a source of truth for supplier relationships, contract commitments, and commercial risk.

 - AI-powered experiences move beyond insights to help users complete high-value procurement work faster and with appropriate human control.

 - The team can distinguish model quality from workflow, data, retrieval, usability, and adoption problems—and improve the right layer.

 - Product investments are tied to measurable outcomes such as time saved, leakage prevented, discounts or rebates captured, faster renewal and amendment preparation, accepted insights, and delegated tasks.

 - Ironclad builds durable shared capabilities that can serve multiple workflows and teams, rather than one-off AI features.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS, workflow products, procurement technology, legal technology, or adjacent business systems.

 - A track record of owning products end to end, from customer discovery and strategy through launch, adoption, and iteration.

 - Deep familiarity with procurement, sourcing, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, legal operations, or a closely related domain.

 - Strong customer empathy and the ability to earn credibility with procurement leaders, lawyers, operators, and technical partners.

 - Experience translating complex workflows, data, and business rules into clear product experiences and requirements.

 - Practical fluency with AI product development, including model capabilities and limitations, evaluation, data quality, retrieval or grounding, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop controls.

 - Strong quantitative judgment and comfort defining success metrics, analyzing product behavior, and making tradeoffs using evidence.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clarity across engineering, design, applied AI, data, GTM, executives, and customers.

 - High ownership, sound product judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building procurement or spend-management products, including procure-to-pay, sourcing, supplier intelligence, contract intelligence, or procurement orchestration.

 - Experience with legal technology, CLM, contract negotiation, obligations, renewals, amendments, or compliance workflows.

 - Experience with enterprise integrations such as SAP, SAP Ariba, Coupa, Zip, Salesforce, or downstream finance and procurement systems.

 - Experience shipping agentic workflows or AI products that can recommend, draft, or take action with user approval.

 - Familiarity with enterprise data models, entity resolution, contract families, knowledge graphs, structured extraction, or document intelligence.

 - Experience making build-versus-buy or vendor-partner decisions for AI, data, or workflow capabilities.

 - Experience launching products in a highly regulated, high-trust, or document-heavy environment.
